reasoning_evidence: NRG guidance 'mid-2028' is consistent across Q3 2025 10-Q, FY2025 10-K, and Q1 2026 10-Q — no further slip as of most recent filing (2026-05-06).
Queue COD drifted 3× over 4 years (2024-12-31 → 2025-06-01 → 2026-06-02 → 2028-05-01) before construction started — historical optimism bias.

TEF loan disbursements ($117M of $370M, ~32%, by Q1 2026) are consistent with a mid-2028 COD: ~18-month average draw schedule from Nov 2025 would exhaust loan ~May 2027, with commissioning to COD taking 12 months.
NRG 10-K risk factors cite supply chain disruption and tariff risk as live cost/schedule threats.
No construction-start milestone yet in ERCOT queue (2026-06 snapshot) — minor flag given SEC confirmation.
Brownfield site at existing major NRG plant: faster permitting, known site, existing infrastructure — favors schedule vs. greenfield.
